parameters.content:
## Pulse Verity Index — signed price observation
1. Select an n8n Bearer Auth credential in BOTH MCP nodes. Store only the developer token in that credential.
2. Edit the symbol in Choose symbol (default BTC).
3. Execute the entire workflow manually. The last node emits VERIFIED only after full-record verification.

VERIFIED describes signature integrity, not freshness, accuracy, or settlement suitability. No trades, transfers, alerts, or automatic retries. Errors stop this execution. See integrations/n8n/README.md.
